name: recruiting-ledger
description: Use the active internal Workspace Recruiting Ledger as the durable source for candidate, employee, and contractor lifecycle state and events.

invocation_policy.semantic_trigger: the active internal Workspace has the Recruiting Ledger installed and the request requires reading, querying, changing, reconciling, or relying on candidate, employee, contractor, hiring, interview, onboarding, offboarding, role, manager, stage, status, or recruiting-ledger evidence, regardless of language
